blocks.text: DSPM leverages ServiceNow APIs to automatically create tickets when sensitive data or a misconfiguration is detected in the cloud resources. You can integrate DSPM with ServiceNow to create incidents on ServiceNow whenever a security policy violation occurs on the selected cloud resources.
Ensure that your ServiceNow instance is online.

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > DSPM Integrations.
Click Add next to the ITSM integration.
The Add ITSM Integration page appears.
On the Add ITSM Integration page, under Integration Details:
Integration Name: Enter a unique name for the integration.
Under ITSM Details, complete the following steps to authorize DSPM to create incidents in ServiceNow:
ServiceNow Hostname: Enter the ServiceNow hostname.
ServiceNow Username: Enter the username for ServiceNow.
ServiceNow Password: Enter the password for ServiceNow.

Test Connection: Click to verify the connection between DSPM and ServiceNow. A message is displayed indicating the connection is verified. If not, then check the previous steps and try again. To learn more, refer to the ServiceNow Guide.
If you need to reset the validation, click Reset Validation, if not, click Next.
Review the integration details on the Summary page. Click the Edit icon if you want to make any changes.

blocks.text: The integration details are displayed on the Integrations page. To complete the integration process and enable data transmission, you must configure and associate the alert notification rules with this integration for DSPM to be able to send the data logs.
